desk.expectations: A professor accepts the grading criteria.
desk.review: Staff review the AI assessment and evidence.
desk.release: A professor confirms the grade and releases feedback.

accounts.profileHelp: You can change your name and student GitHub username. Contact an administrator for academic identity corrections.
accounts.boundary: Manage accounts and content-free operations only. This workspace does not grant access to academic assessments, artifacts or private conversations.
accounts.correctionHelp: Only TA/professor role changes are supported. Corrections affect future access; historical submissions, rosters and attribution are not rewritten. No account deletion is available.
accounts.selfWarning: This is your account. Suspension will sign you out. The last active admin cannot be suspended.
accounts.confirm: Apply these account corrections? Suspension blocks existing sessions. Recheck the identity and academic fields before confirming.
accounts.auditHelp: Events recorded from Phase 5 onward. IDs and changed field names only; no previous values, private content or reconstructed historical events. Action and field identifiers are stable technical codes.
accounts.metricsHelp: Durable application AI calls, not provider billing or individual model retry counts. No prompts, replies or identities. Incomplete means started without a recorded outcome. Unknown provenance is not counted as live or mock. Latency is measured at the application boundary; provider identifiers remain technical codes.

tagline: Learn with clarity. Review with confidence.
name: Full name
demo: Local / demo workspace · Staff roles are self-selected for demonstration only.
loginHint: Your tasks, progress and feedback in one place.
registerHint: Choose your role to get started.
permission: You do not have permission to open this workspace.
unavailable: This workspace is not available for administrators.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
error: The request could not be completed. Your input has been kept.
ambiguous: The server may have completed this request. Refresh before trying again.
studentIntro: Focus on what is next, then revisit your feedback.
staffIntro: Prepare expectations, review evidence, release useful feedback.
title: Title
allowLate: Allow late submissions until grade confirmation
requireTeam: Require a team (submissions unavailable in this release)
timezone: Dates are shown in your local timezone.
taskSetup: Define the work and its audience. Creating a task makes it visible immediately.
fileHelp: Text, a file, or both. Maximum file size: 25 MiB.
uploaded: File uploaded. Your attempt is not submitted yet.
resubmitHelp: This creates a new attempt. Earlier attempts and their artifacts remain in your history.
noArtifact: No stored text is available for this historical attempt.
fileOnly: This attempt contains a file without additional text.
awaiting: Your work has been received. Feedback will appear after your professor confirms the grade.
mockNotice: This is sample feedback from mock mode, not a genuine academic assessment.
refineFeedback: What should the next version improve?
approveWarning: Students will see the criterion names, descriptions and points. Remove model answers or private marking notes before approval. This version becomes active for new submissions; historical attempts retain their original rubric.
evaluating: AI evaluation is running. This can take a few minutes.
releaseWarning: This becomes the student's official grade and releases the assessment. Further submissions will be closed.
overrideNotice: Criterion scores remain the AI assessment even when you override the overall final grade.
deleteWarning: This permanently removes the task and related rubrics, attempts, file records and academic review history.
noRubrics: Create a rubric, then ask a professor to approve it.
accountCreated: Account created. Sign in to continue.
refreshDone: Server state refreshed. Check the latest records before retrying.

tutor.title: Ask AI tutor
tutor.guidance: Get hints, explanations and debugging guidance—not completed answers. AI can make mistakes.
tutor.privacy: Your conversation is private unless you explicitly share a snapshot with a staff member.
tutor.shareHelp: Preview completed turns up to your chosen question. Only the named recipient can read this snapshot; later messages remain private.
tutor.shareWarning: Share the previewed conversation with this staff recipient?
tutor.sharedSuccess: Snapshot shared with the selected recipient.
tutor.revokeWarning: This blocks future access but cannot retract content already seen.
tutor.snapshotNotice: Read-only snapshots explicitly shared with you. Later conversation messages are not included.
tutor.settingsHelp: Applies to future tutor turns. Private model answers are never passed to the tutor.
tutor.legacyNotice: Preserved messages from before turn tracking. AI provenance is unknown; these messages are not included in new shares.
tutor.choose: Choose a conversation or start a new one.
tutor.mock: Demo tutor · Mock AI, not a real model response
tutor.truncated: Some context was shortened to fit the tutor's limit.
tutor.failed: The tutor could not finish this response. Your question is saved.
tutor.question: Your question
tutor.pasteHelp: Up to 4,000 characters. Paste a focused code excerpt if needed; uploaded artifacts are not read automatically.

guidance.title: Private grading guidance
guidance.help: Staff-only marking notes. Each save creates an immutable version. Only grading uses this content; tutors and rubric generation never receive it.
guidance.warning: Assessment feedback may be released to students. Check that AI feedback, criterion reasoning and findings do not reveal private solutions before confirming a grade. Prompt safeguards are not a guarantee.
guidance.clearHelp: Maximum 12,000 characters. Save an empty version to stop using guidance for future evaluations; previous versions remain preserved.
guidance.confirm: Save a new private version for future evaluations? Earlier evaluations keep their original version.
guidance.clearConfirm: Save an empty version? Future evaluations will receive no private guidance; existing versions are preserved.
guidance.none: No private guidance has been saved.
guidance.disabled: Empty version — no private guidance supplied.
guidance.next: Evaluation will use the latest private guidance available when grading starts.
guidance.unknown: No private guidance version recorded (none supplied or historical evaluation).

insights.title: Teaching insights
insights.help: Staff-only teaching support from each student's latest professor-confirmed result. Pending and AI-only results are excluded. Rubric versions are analyzed separately.
insights.insufficient: At least {count} released results using this rubric are needed. Statistics and AI analysis are unavailable below this threshold.
insights.provenance: Assessment provenance: {mock} mock, {unknown} unknown. Mock assessment data is demonstration evidence, not real academic measurement.
insights.criteriaHelp: These are the original AI criterion scores, not redistributed professor overrides. Missing or ambiguous historical criteria are excluded. A dash means too few valid samples. Below 60% is a descriptive indicator, not an academic decision.
insights.caution: Suggestions are not established misconceptions or automated academic decisions. AI receives numeric grades and aggregated criterion/severity evidence only—no identities, student work, feedback or chats. Reports keep their original language and snapshot.
insights.noReports: No report generated yet. Generation is an explicit staff action.
insights.stale: Outdated snapshot — released results have changed. Generate a new report for current evidence.
insights.mock: Demo teaching report · Mock AI, not a real model analysis

teams.title: Project teams
teams.individual: Membership never shares individual submissions, grades, files or chats.
teams.name: Team name
teams.createHelp: Creating a team records your consent to join. Invite classmates by exact student number.
teams.previewHelp: Review the roster before accepting. Joining shares your name and student number with the team and teaching staff.
teams.rosterWarning: Roster changes invalidate approval. Review the members before continuing.
teams.consent: Accept only if you agree to join this roster. Your academic work remains private.
teams.declineWarning: Decline this invitation? You will not join this team.
teams.inviteHelp: Only students in this project's cohort and major can join. No student directory is exposed.
teams.approveWarning: Approve this exact, consented roster? The first team-linked submission permanently locks membership.
teams.archiveWarning: Archive this team and release memberships? Roster history is retained.
teams.submissionHelp: This is your individual attempt for team {id}. Submitting locks the approved roster for everyone.

repos.title: Public GitHub repositories
repos.help: Propose a public repository for this approved project team. Teaching staff approve the link before it can be used as evidence.
repos.noScoring: Commit counts are not effort scores or grades. Username attribution requires staff review; submissions and feedback remain individual.
repos.publicWarning: Only public GitHub repositories are supported. Repository contents are saved for academic review; never include secrets or private information.
repos.fixture: DEMO GitHub fixture — not real repository evidence
repos.omitted: Files excluded from initial AI input: {count}. Further evaluation limits may apply.
repos.snapshotHelp: This archive is pinned to the displayed commit. Later repository changes cannot alter it. No code was executed.
repos.partial: History is partial or has not been synchronized. Only up to 100 recent default-branch commits are read per sync.
repos.bounded: Last sync read fewer than 100 default-branch commits. This is not a complete contribution record.
repos.approvalWarning: Review this public link and the current approved roster. Approval replaces the previous active link but preserves its evidence and history.
repos.noCommits: No commits imported. Use explicit sync after approval.
repos.attributionWarning: Confirm or correct the student association based on reviewed evidence. This does not establish effort or change any grade. Corrections remain in history.
repos.captureHelp: Save an archive before submitting. Limit: 25 MiB compressed, 100 MiB expanded, 1,000 files. If GitHub fails, text/file submission remains available.
repos.choose: Choose repository evidence instead of a file
